decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's established coating technology to a niche protective-coatings market, so carrying it costs little while its value is still uncertain.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field use in construction repair, so the evidence supports keeping the option open rather than dropping it.
The transfer pump line reuses the firm's proven air motors and sits close to its core business, so its carrying cost is low and its value is likely to be realized.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization goals, still has uncertain prospects, and is cheap to keep, so the option is worth holding.
The hydraulic two-component sprayer launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and dropping it would be premature.
